title: How to Price a Product in 2026 (+ Pricing Calculator) - Shopify

facts.fact: The article is dated September 3, 2026, per its byline.
The article has an estimated reading time of 17 minutes.
The guide states that it covers five proven pricing strategies.
facts.quote: This guide shows you how to price a product using step-by-step formulas, a free calculator, and five proven pricing strategies.

facts.fact: Shopify describes its product cost calculator as free to use for tracking expenses and product costs.
facts.quote: Use this free product cost calculator to track expenses and understand all the costs involved in bringing your products to market.

facts.fact: The page gives the basic cost-plus pricing formula as cost plus markup equals selling price.
The page defines product pricing as setting selling prices based on production costs, market conditions, and profit goals.
facts.quote: Product pricing is the process of setting selling prices for your products based on production costs, market conditions, and profit goals.
